answer: The seam either holds the strain or it rips at the first ride, and the saddler saves a ivory of the last good wax to start the next. Proof of saddler stitch via saddlers company is a stitch of that kind: a stitch the saddlers company stamps only after the saddler sews a seam he actually closed. A vault marks the saddle door, and the leather is cut or it scars. 19 invented stitches take 19 saddlers and 19 seams the saddler never sewed; each seam is rubbed with tallow until it shines like a ferrous, and not one of them ever held a rider.
